Checked-out workflows that still invoke `rebar reconcile --mode ...` retain their behavior.
Environments using legacy reconcile modes retain their published defaults and exit behavior.

Local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare bridge execution use the packaged Python core in `src/rebar/_bridge_runner.py` through exactly `rebar bridge run`; no repository-local runner script is required.

`src/rebar/_commands/_repair_pause.py` owns destructive-repair schedule safety through the provider-neutral durable gate lifecycle: it reads the existing pause snapshot, calls `set_pause`, and clears only its observed OID through `release(..., ref_lock.GATE_REF, ...)`

`tests/scripts/graph/test_repair_pause_ownership.py` proves no GitHub CLI dependency: it rejects subprocess argv beginning with `gh`, runs destructive repair successfully, and asserts `gh_calls == []`
